messages:
ben: inbound SIG/CAIQ from Oakridge Financial — ~92 questions, customer requested answers + cert PDFs. RFP deadline is next Fri EOD PST. can security pick this up? @miguel ? link: https://files.redwood.ai/questionnaires/OKF-2026-SIG.xlsx :eyes:

miguel: i can take primary ownership. quick q — do they want line-item evidence (cert pdfs) or just narrative/high-level controls? that affects how long this will take.

ben: they explicitly said "certs + specifics" in the sales thread. also asking about KMS key control, VPC peering details, and SOC2 scope for Dedicated vs Private. lauren is coordinating contracts, FYI.

lauren: confirming — Oakridge needs SOC2 report and proof of KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred). target to have draft answers to share with the customer by Thu 3pm PT.

miguel: OK. initial plan: 1) triage questions into (A) cert requests, (B) architecture/KMS/network answers, (C) policy/process items; 2) pull certs and SOC2 report from vault; 3) draft narratives for A/B/C and flag anything needing engineering input. assigning myself and pinging eng if needed.

tara: I have a Dedicated POC config with sample KMS and VPC peering docs — can paste sanitized snippet for the architecture answers. small sample: ```
# Dedicated KMS example (sanitized)
key_policy: customer_managed
kms_provider: AWS-KMS
key_rotation_days: 365
vpc_peering: explicit-allow-list
```

miguel: thanks — that snippet is perfect. can you also export a one-page topology diagram (png) and a short text for egress controls? customer asked about outbound filtering for PCI workloads.

tara: will export and upload to the questionnaire folder in ~30m.

ben: flagging priority: sales says this RFP blocks the underwriting signoff for the pilot — high urgency. please mark task as "urgent" in the intake queue. :exclamation:

miguel: added to security intake queue. plan timeline: draft answers Wed EOD, internal review Thu morning, deliver Thu 3pm PT. if anything critical pops up we'll escalate.

ops-bot: SOC2 report (redwood-soc2-2025.pdf) and ISO attestation uploaded to /vault/reports/Oakridge/ — link: https://vault.redwood.ai/reports/Oakridge/ (access logged).

miguel: grabbed SOC2 and ISO. still need the KMS key rotation record and a short audit log extract — @tara can you pull rotation timestamps from the POC env or provide a sanitized sample?

tara: can do. note: the POC uses customer-managed keys for Private, but Dedicated uses our KMS with customer key wrap — i'll include both variants and call out the differences.

ben: thanks everyone. next steps: miguel to upload draft answers to the questionnaire file in the shared folder by Thu 3pm PT; tara to upload topology + KMS samples; lauren to prep gating language for contracts if they push for customer-managed keys. i'll follow up with the customer once we have the draft. :thumbsup:

miguel: putting a check-in calendar invite for Wed 11am PT for reviewers. if anyone sees blockers before then reply here.

lauren: got the invite. will prep a short cover email template for the delivery explaining what is evidence vs narrative.

ben: appreciate the quick turnaround team — this one looks like a likely pilot win if we clear the paperwork.

miguel: draft uploaded to https://files.redwood.ai/questionnaires/OKF-2026-SIG-draft.xlsx — please review and add inline comments. last_message_ts: 2360004321"
